title: WHISPER A PRAYER IN THE MORNING
stanzas: Whisper a prayer in the morning, Whisper a prayer in the noon, Whisper a prayer in the evening, To keep your heart in tune.
God answers prayer in the morning, God answers prayer in the noon, God answers prayer in the evening, To keep your heart in tune.
Jesus may come in the morning, Jesus may come in the noon, Jesus may come in the evening, To keep your heart in tune.
